messages.content: You are a rigorous and creative machine-learning researcher. Give one concrete original method candidate, with equations if useful. Do not claim literature novelty has been established.

We are developing a conference research project, initially about shared world-model security; a positive methods pivot is allowed. Need ONE concrete algorithmic idea whose core concept can be stated broadly in one sentence, not a narrower application of an existing attack. Do not pretend novelty is verified. We have real native experiments: WorldEvolver/WorldMind develop wrong persistent forecasts from authentic experience, yet strong actors measure reality and finish tasks; DiscoveryWorld real misleading interventions are corrected locally; TD-MPC2 full MPC resists shared normalization and query warm-start perturbations. A DMO final mean-head Jacobian perturbation cannot both reverse derivatives and preserve forward accuracy in a fixed short screen. This suggests using actual closed-loop learning mechanisms rather than assuming prediction damage is task damage.
Already close prior art rules out these as sole contributions: active-learning poisoning/self-confirming beliefs; optimizer-state poisoning; generic future-plasticity denial; function-preserving spectral deformation controls future learning (HarmAlign); correct outputs with wrong input gradients; shared executable experiments plus local validation (DAD, Meta-Causal Discovery, HExA, VERDI); joint control/adaptation meta-learning (COML); first-correction stopping kernels (standard option/SMDP abstraction); contribution replay of old/new memory (HiMPO, MGPO, C3, CREDO); Lie brackets of learning updates (Commutator Memory); trajectory promotion to shared skills (When Experience Becomes Instruction / SkillClaw); procedural coordination principle sharing (RELIC/CORAL).
Do NOT respond with a list, literature audit, or invent references. Think of a genuinely different computed object or learning operation that uses the observed correction phenomenon. State exactly inputs, update, decision use, strong comparison, what observation would disprove it, and a bounded pilot using actual DMControl/TD-MPC2/DiscoveryWorld/ScienceWorld or small exact scientific construction. Full simulator/planner must stay intact; no weakened baseline or renamed bug. Distinguish mathematical novelty hypotheses from established facts. An algorithm can be new even if expressible by generic RL, but replacing only names/application is not enough. Aim for an executable mathematical operation, not a slogan. If there is no concrete promising idea, say so briefly.
